# Packages
```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

# Data 
```{r}
# name <- 
#   c("Adeshina", "Brendan", "Jayden", "Kylie", "Nora", "Gia", "Aston", 
#     "Marshawn", "Jemilah", "Guy", "Alaiya", "Aymir", "Jourdan", "Anhala", 
#     "Ameerah", "Michael", "Jallbe", "A’Zyiah", "Amira", "Keiano", "Mylah", 
#     "Tristan", "Rhegan", "Ariana", "Aubrelle")
# 
# sex <-
#   c("M", "M", "M", "F", "F", "F", "M", 
#     "M", "F", "M", "F", "M", "F", "F", 
#     "F", "M", "M", "F", "F", "M", "F", 
#     "M", "F", "F", "F")
# 
# domain1assessment <-
#   c(16, 21, NA, NA, NA, 22, NA, 
#     12, NA, 17, 21, 23, 12, 19, 
#     17, 10, 19, 15, 16, 19, 10, 
#     13, 19, 14, 20)
# 
# domain2assessment <-
#   c(10.5, 23.5, 10, 15.5, NA, 18.5, 20, 
#     4, 16.5, 15, 19, 17.5, 16, 13.5, 
#     15.5, 12.5, 19.5, 14.5, 15.5, 15, 12.5, 
#     NA, 17.5, 16.5, 18.5)
# 
# d <- tibble(name = name,
#             sex = sex,
#             domain1assessment = domain1assessment,
#             domain2assessment = domain2assessment)
# 
# excel <- write.csv(d, "d.csv")
```

```{r}
d <- read.csv("d.csv")

d <- d |>
  mutate(perc_d1 = domain1assessment/26,
         perc_d2 = domain2assessment/27,
         perc_d3 = domain3assessment/27)

d_long_scores <- d |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("domain"),
               names_to = "score")

d_long_perc <- d |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("perc"),
               names_to = "percentage")


```

# Visualizations
```{r}
d_long_perc |>
  ggplot(aes(y = name, x = value, color = percentage)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
d_plot <- d |>
  mutate(diff23 = perc_d3 - perc_d2) |>
  arrange(name, by = reading_group)

d_plot |>
  ggplot(aes(x = diff23, y = name, color = reading_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-0.2, 0.4, 0.05)) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
d_plot |>
  ggplot(aes(x = diff23, fill = reading_group)) +
  geom_density() +
  facet_wrap(~ reading_group) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
d |>
  mutate(diff23 = perc_d3 / perc_d2) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = diff23)) +
           geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1) +
           theme_bw()
```
